title: cestichis coelogynoides
intro: Cestichis coelogynoides, commonly known as the Australian native orchid, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to provide various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving respiratory function, and acting as an expectorant to relieve coughs and congestion. The therapeutic actions of Cestichis coelogynoides include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and bronchodilatory properties, which make it useful in treating conditions such as bronchitis, asthma, and other respiratory disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
